title: Northrop YB-49 jet flying wing in flight (Fig. 7)
description: Photograph of the Northrop YB-49 flying wing viewed diagonally from above against a light background, showing vertical fins on the trailing edge. Text above describes it as powered by eight turbo-jet engines and the jet-propelled version of the Northrop Flying Wing (B-35). Captioned "Fig. 7".
